_README: SPONSORS AND GRANTS — shown in the 'Generosity & Support' section on the homepage.
Edit the 'sponsors' list below. You may list ONE, TWO, or THREE sponsors.
The section lays itself out to match, so two sponsors fill the row evenly
and three fit side by side. Adding a fourth will not display.
eyebrow  small line above the name, e.g. 'Established 1994'
tagline  one short line under the name
amount   the grant, e.g. '$5,000'. Leave as "" to hide the badge.
body     a short paragraph. Two or three sentences is plenty.
note     small line at the bottom of the card
Anything you leave as "" is simply left out, so a sparse entry still looks right.
Keep the quotes and commas exactly as they appear, or the file will not load.

sponsors.name: Frankie Poulos Foundation
sponsors.tagline: In loving memory of Frankie Poulos, championing Novato's youth
sponsors.body: Founded by Jim and Kelly Poulos, the foundation has contributed over $400,000 to local youth institutions. Their grant went directly into keeping our program running.

sponsors.name: School Fuel
sponsors.tagline: Funding programs across the Novato Unified School District
sponsors.body: School Fuel's investment keeps San Marin debaters travelling to premier Bay Area invitationals, which matters more every year as our costs grow alongside the size of the team.
